name: Rusty Dagger
desc: A worn blade, better than bare hands.

name: Iron Sword
desc: A sturdy iron blade, honest and slow.

name: Hazel Wand
desc: Cut green and never dried. It carries a spell further than it carries a blow.

name: Bronze Shortsword
desc: Soft metal. It bends before it breaks, and it is quick about both.

name: Woodsman's Hatchet
desc: Not made for this. It does not know the difference.

name: Chapel Censer
desc: It still smells of the service. Swung, it argues.

name: Battle Axe
desc: Powerful, and it arrives late.

name: Silver Rapier
desc: Light enough to lead with. Quick hands matter more than strong ones.

name: Magic Rod
desc: Channels what you have learned, and asks nothing of your arm.

name: Steel Longsword
desc: What the iron sword was trying to be.

name: Fire Sword
desc: The edge holds a coal that never goes out. Every swing carries it.

name: Ice Sword
desc: Cold enough that the wound closes wrong.

name: Thunder Sword
desc: It stands your hair up before it lands.

name: Runed Glaive
desc: A long reach with something written down the flat of it.

name: Headsman's Maul
desc: It only has to land once.

name: Witch's Focus
desc: A knot of blackthorn around a stone. It does the thinking.

name: Mythril Sword
desc: Lighter than it has any right to be. Nothing about it argues with your wrist.

name: Silver Sword
desc: Silver was always the metal they buried things with. It expels rather than cuts.

name: Obsidian Edge
desc: A glass edge one atom wide, and the dark comes along for free.

name: Flamberge
desc: The waved blade was for show. What runs down it now is not.

name: Drakebone Sabre
desc: Cut from something that was still arguing at the time.

name: Titan's Cleaver
desc: Made for a larger hand. You manage.

name: Sorcerer's Crook
desc: Bone, and still warm. Whatever it was taken from knew a great deal.

name: Diamond Sword
desc: Nothing down here has managed to blunt it yet.

name: Rimefang Greatsword
desc: Two hands, and the air in front of it goes white.

name: Excalibur
desc: It was in a stone, and then it was in a lake, and now it is down here with you.
